standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.high: A14B 只挂高噪塔，偏结构和大动作，省一塔显存。

standard_en.summary: t2v-a14b only: a high/low single tower
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.high: Attaches only to A14B's high-noise tower, which leans towards structure and large motion, and saves one tower's worth of VRAM.
optionDescriptions.low: Attaches only to the low-noise tower, which leans towards refining detail.

advanced.principle: 仅 t2v-a14b：每次训练选择 high 或 low 单塔；当前产品不提供 both 双塔训练。

advanced_en.principle: t2v-a14b only: each training run picks a single high or low tower; the product currently offers no both dual-tower training.
